findings.claim: Microsoft 於 2025-09 發表晶片內微流道冷卻技術，冷卻劑直接流過蝕刻在矽晶粒上的微通道；Microsoft 稱散熱效率最高可達現行冷板的 3 倍、峰值溫升最多降 65%（屬冷板的潛在替代路線）。
findings.source: Tom's Hardware, Microsoft develops breakthrough chip cooling method — microfluidic channels can cut peak temps by up to 65%, outperform conventional cold plates by up to 3x
findings.excerpt: Microsoft develops breakthrough chip cooling method — microfluidic channels can cut peak temps by up to 65%, outperform conventional cold plates by up to 3x

findings.claim: Corintis 主張微流道冷卻將蝕刻於處理器封裝內而非外接冷板，並稱要在 2026 年底前擴產至百萬片冷板規模；資料來源另指微流體與浸沒式冷卻被視為 2026 年資料中心冷卻的關鍵技術（可與冷板並行或取代）。
findings.source: IEEE Spectrum, Microfluidics Could Be the Answer to Cooling AI Chips; Data Centre Insight, How Microfluidics and Immersion Cooling is Key for Data Centre Cooling 'Breakthrough' (2025-12-23)
findings.excerpt: How Microfluidics and Immersion Cooling is Key for Data Centre Cooling ‘Breakthrough’

findings.claim: Nvidia 將 Vera Rubin 液冷標準化，集中採購冷板並點名四家供應商（AVC、Cooler Master、Jentech、Delta）；Vera Rubin 機櫃採全液冷、無風扇設計。AVC 為列名供應商之一，目前路線為冷板而非被取代。
findings.source: Digitimes, Nvidia standardizes Vera Rubin liquid cooling, names four cold plate suppliers
findings.excerpt: Nvidia standardizes Vera Rubin liquid cooling, names four cold plate suppliers

findings.claim: 產業文章指 Rubin 世代單晶片 TDP 達約 2300W、機櫃約 200kW，超過單相冷板約 150kW/機櫃的設計上限，需要相變冷板或微通道蓋板（MLCP）等新方案；MLCP 被視為 Rubin 架構的優先方案（二手產業網站，未經 Nvidia 或供應商證實，需另行查證）。
findings.source: tonecooling.com, NVIDIA Rubin GPU Cooling Challenges
